verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is itself an official CLI (`tofu`), with documented commands such as plan, test and import, a CLI docs section, multiple install methods including an official OCI image, and machine-readable output (`-json`/`-json-into`) suited to automated and agent workflows. Community users corroborate using it in real migrations. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable output beyond `tofu test` (e.g., JSON plan output for agents), and explicit agent- or AI-oriented CLI guidance.
